properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 28 at 3:16PM EDT until August 28 at 5:45PM EDT by NWS Mount Holly NJ
properties.description:
At 316 PM EDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated that
heavy rain had fallen over the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of
rain have fallen. Flooding impacts will continue, but no additional
rainfall is expected. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Tuckerton, Surf City, Port Republic, Bass River State Forest, New
Gretna, Beach Haven West and Mystic Island.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 28 at 3:54PM EDT until August 28 at 4:45PM EDT by NWS Raleigh NC
properties.description:
SVRRAH

The National Weather Service in Raleigh has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Southeastern Moore County in central North Carolina...
Northeastern Scotland County in central North Carolina...
Southwestern Harnett County in central North Carolina...
Western Cumberland County in central North Carolina...
Hoke County in central North Carolina...

* Until 445 PM EDT.

* At 353 PM EDT, a cluster of severe thunderstorms extending from 9
miles northeast of Pope AAF to near Fort Bragg to 6 miles south of
Aberdeen, moving south at 10 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Fayetteville, Southern Pines, Raeford, Fort Bragg, Aberdeen,
Antioch, Pope AAF, Hope Mills, Spring Lake, and Eastover.

This includes Interstate 95 between Mile Markers 58 and 41.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.
